subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should OpenClaw add a core status-card visibility setting for chat `/status` and `session_status`, and should it hide the whole card or only privacy-sensitive sections such as usage and cost?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the permanent output shape and new config surface affect privacy, agent UX, docs, and schema compatibility, so automation should not choose the product contract on its own.

options.title: Add a documented visibility contract
options.body: Introduce a default-on setting or section allowlist that preserves current output while allowing operators to suppress the chat/tool status card or sensitive lines.

options.title: Limit the change to privacy sections
options.body: Add only usage/cost suppression if maintainers want to solve the sensitive-data concern without creating a broad status-card mode.

options.title: Reject the new config surface
options.body: Keep status cards always visible and close the request as not planned if the extra configuration is not worth the complexity.

recommendation.title: Add a documented visibility contract
recommendation.body: Introduce a default-on setting or section allowlist that preserves current output while allowing operators to suppress the chat/tool status card or sensitive lines.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the original tool surface and already framed this as the canonical product tracker in the discussion.
